episodes.title: That's How Love Starts, Ya Know?
episodes.summary: Momo is a high school girl born to a family of spirit mediums, and Okarun is an occult fanatic. To settle an argument, Momo heads to an abandoned hospital famous for UFO sightings while Okarun heads to a tunnel famous as a spiritual hotspot.

episodes.title: That's A Space Alien, Ain't It?!
episodes.summary: Okarun is cursed by Turbo Granny, and Momo uses her newly found psychic powers to curb Turbo Granny from running out of control. Dawn breaks, and the two of them temporarily find shelter in Momo's house.

episodes.title: It's A Granny Vs. Granny Clash!
episodes.summary: After Momo's grandmother temporarily suppresses the evil spirit within Okarun, she says that a game of tag may be the key to defeating it for good.

episodes.title: Kicking Turbo Granny's Ass
episodes.summary: To settle the score with Turbo Granny, Momo and Okarun show up at the promised tunnel. They start the game of tag to pull the location-bound spirit away, and they managed to capture Turbo Granny using Momo's psychic powers.

episodes.title: Like, Where Are Your Balls?!
episodes.summary: Victorious against Turbo Granny, Momo and Okarun regain peace. They have gotten closer through the traumatic experience, but they find their relationship to be awkward. That is when Okarun discloses something important to Momo.

episodes.title: A Dangerous Woman Arrives
episodes.summary: Momo, Okarun, and Turbo Granny search for the missing golden ball. They search all over the school and find out that a pretty girl named Aira is in possession of a ball. Perhaps the effects of the ball, but Aira can now see "invisible things" now.

episodes.title: To a Kinder World
episodes.summary: Momo and Okarun manage to pull Acrobatic Silky away from Aira after a fierce battle. However, Aira herself had lost her life as a side-effect of being eaten by a yokai monster. Facing Aira in such a crisis, Acrobatic Silky has a surprising proposal…

episodes.title: I've Got This Funny Feeling
episodes.summary: The battle against Acrobatic Silky is over, Aira harbors romantic feelings stemming from how Okarun had saved her. As Momo, Okarun, and Aira's feelings intertwine, Serpoians make another appearance, and the three of them are trapped in void space.

episodes.title: Merge! Serpo Dover Demon Nessie!
episodes.summary: Aira has awakened the powers of Acrobatic Silky within her and proceeds to have a seesaw battle against the Serpoians and the Dover Demon. Momo and Okarun join the fray, intensifying the battle.

episodes.title: Have You Ever Seen a Cattle Mutilation?
episodes.summary: Okarun and the girls try to clear up some misunderstandings with their classmates. Later, the aquatic creature reappears before Momo and Aira.

episodes.title: First Love
episodes.summary: Momo's childhood friend, Jiji, appears and begins living in Momo's house. Jiji has been worrying about apparitions in the house he moved into. Okarun is clearly disturbed hearing that Jiji is Momo's first love and tries to distance himself from Momo.

episodes.title: Let's Go to the Cursed House
episodes.summary: Momo and Okarun head to Jiji's house in a hot springs district to investigate the case of Jiji's family. Okarun feels gloomy looking at how close Momo and Jiji are. Arriving at Jiji's house, there are several shadows watching them as they enter...

episodes.title: Like, This Is the Legend of the Giant Snake
episodes.summary: As Momo fends off an attack in the outdoor hot spring, Okarun and Jiji panic over how to handle the mysterious room. Just then, the doorbell rings.

episodes.title: The Evil Eye
episodes.summary: Jiji tries to stop Momo and Okarun, who are being controlled by telepathic waves, from committing suicide.

episodes.title: You Won't Get Away With This!
episodes.summary: Jiji's body becomes possessed by the Evil Eye.

episodes.title: That's, Like, Way Deadly!
episodes.summary: Momo succeeds in bringing the Mongolian Death Worm to the surface.

episodes.title: We Can All Stay There Together!
episodes.summary: Momo succeeds in rescuing Okarun. They return safely to their home, but Jiji is still possessed by Evil Eye.

episodes.title: We Became a Family
episodes.summary: Jiji's transformation into Evil Eye intensifies. The group tries to exorcize Evil Eye from Jiji's body with a Hayashi performance. They invite the Hayashi and almost succeed in pushing Evil Eye out, but Jiji pleads with them to not kill Evil Eye...

episodes.title: Feeling Kinda Gloomy
episodes.summary: Seiko teaches Jiji how to hold back the Evil Eye. However, Jiji struggles keeping him at bay. Jiji turns into Evil Eye and assaults Momo. With some quick thinking, Momo somehow manages to get through the situation, while Okarun is determined to get stronger so he can send Evil Eye packing.

episodes.title: You Can Do It, Okarun!
episodes.summary: Okarun and Aira end up fighting against classical composers lurking in the school music room for training. Aira gradually gets the hang of it, but Okarun is unable to dodge the composers' flying musical note bomb attacks. Turbo Granny gives Okarun some advice, telling him to move his body to the rhythm.

episodes.title: I Want to Rebuild the House
episodes.summary: The battle between Okarun and Evil Eye-fied Jiji has begun. Showing the results of his training, Okarun fights toe-to-toe against Evil Eye, going "full throttle." However, he can't fully defeat Evil Eye. And then, Okarun's transformation is undone…

episodes.title: The Secret Art of Being Attractive
episodes.summary: Momo gets information about a "golden ball" from Miko and Muko. She immediately heads over to Okarun's class to tell him and notices that he is talking to a slightly chubby male student. After school, Momo and Okarun head over to the apartment building rumored to be the site of the golden ball sightings. The chubby boy, Kinta, is following them...

episodes.title: Hey, it's a Kaiju
episodes.summary: The sky darkens as Momo, Okarun and Kinta try to evade the giant space monster. They soon run into Aira and Jiji, who give them some much-needed help.

episodes.title: Clash! Space Kaiju vs. Giant Robot!
